name: worktrees
description: Rebase a branch onto the head branch through its conflicts, and remove the git worktrees and branches the worktrees CLI proves finished

interface.shortDescription: Rebase onto the head branch; remove finished worktrees
interface.longDescription: Ask the worktrees CLI which linked worktrees and local branches are finished, show the ones it proved with the proof it found, and remove only those you choose, through the CLI. A squash merge leaves branches behind that git branch -d calls unmerged; the CLI proves them merged by ancestry, by content or by the forge's merged request, and prints the command that puts each one back. It also rebases the branch you are on onto the head branch, resolving each conflict the rebase stops at, and moves a merged branch's checkout to a new branch.
capabilities: List the worktrees and branches proved finished, with the proof
Remove only the ones you choose, through the CLI
Print the command that restores each removed branch
Rebase this branch onto the head branch and resolve its conflicts
defaultPrompt: Clean up the finished worktrees and branches here.
Which of my branches are already merged?
Prune the squash-merged branches in this repository.
Bring this branch up to date with main.
